title: Function tenant context, batch 2: procedure-action, manage-user-role, model-attachment-upload, public-forms, reader-settings
description: Move these handlers to the TenantContext (build_event_tenant_context / buildEventTenantContext, actingFor, tenantScopedClient) exactly as PR 1 did for content-actions, category-action, assignment-action, newsroom-summary and editorial-checks. Remove each from PENDING in scripts/test-function-tenant-context.ts. Spec: features_backend/function-tenant-context.feature. Each PR green on its own.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Needs decisions before code: procedure-action lists whole ProcedureDefinition, ProcedureVersion and ProcedureRun tables and finds a definition by key in memory, and names records procedure-definition-<key>: on a shared stack the ids need the tenant and the lists need tenant indexes (none exist; GSI ledger: one new index per table per release). model-attachment-upload builds S3 keys from owner ids, and the visual-style profile has one global owner id (item-editorial-doctrine-visual-style). public-forms and reader-settings have no signed-in tenant claim (Function URL and reader sessions): their tenant is the host's (TenantDomain). manage-user-role works on the global identity models.
